text: Let me share a little experience for any patients planning to use the services, or as a message to the dentists here. The clinic is clean, and both dentists are lovely, friendly, and give good advice, even chatting with patients 😊. I've been here twice, once a year, mainly for wisdom tooth extractions. The only thing I'd like to see improved is the service from the front counter staff. This is a public area, and I won't mention names, but there was a pregnant woman who spoke well, to a certain extent, but her manners and demeanor when interacting with patients need significant improvement. She should be sent for training on proper customer service etiquette, such as learning how to stand and converse with clients. For example, on December 28th, 2024, when I used my social security benefits, she threw/slammed the social security booklet down on the patient, slammed the pen into the book, slammed the dispenser down, and most importantly, when about to scan to pay... (Anyone using the Bangkok Bank app to pay, after scanning, you have to enter a password, the amount, and then press the confirmation button—it's complicated.) I tried to show her my phone the transfer amount, but the bank errored, so I had to scan again. Then that pregnant woman made a displeased sound, like she was clicking her tongue against the roof of her mouth. Is that acceptable behavior from an employee towards a customer? 😒 I also saw her bored expression. We weren't asking for anything free; we were paying. I'm so confused. They didn't even give us a bag for our medicine. Was she the clinic owner? I hope the doctor will train and educate this kind of behavior on you. 😏😌 #Worst
